title: Whole-scheme affine tensor sections
statement: Let $A,B$ be affine schemes, $f:B\to A$ a scheme morphism, and $G$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_A$-module [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-affine-sections]. Give $\Gamma(B,\mathcal O_B)$ its algebra structure over $\Gamma(A,\mathcal O_A)$ through $f^\sharp$. There is a bijective additive map from $\Gamma(A,G)\otimes_{\Gamma(A,\mathcal O_A)}\Gamma(B,\mathcal O_B)$ to $\Gamma(B,f^*G)$, taking $m\otimes b$ to $b$ times the global-section unit pullback of $m$ [lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-presheaf-functorial].

source.place: Tags 01I9, lemma-widetilde-pullback; 01IA, lemma-quasi-coherent-affine; whole-scheme specialization of the affine pullback sections comparison.

proof.text:
apply exists_tensorPullback_affine_sections to the affine opens consisting of
all of A and B. The inclusion into the inverse image of the whole scheme is automatic.
The induced ring map appLE is appTop: its extra restriction is the identity presheaf
map. Specialize the family of linear maps to G and forget its scalar structure to
obtain an additive map. Bijectivity is the bijectivity clause of that comparison.
The pure-tensor clause says that m tensor b maps to b times the adjunction unit of m,
restricted from the inverse image of top to top. This is exactly tensorSectionsUnit.
The proof uses no nonemptiness: the zero module and empty affine schemes are included.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affineTopTensorSections {A B : Scheme.{u}} (f : B ⟶ A)
    (G : A.Modules) (hG : G.IsQuasicoherent) (hA : IsAffine A) (hB : IsAffine B) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(A, ⊤) Γ(B, ⊤) := f.appTop.hom.toAlgebra
    ∃ d : (Γ(G, ⊤) ⊗[Γ(A, ⊤)] Γ(B, ⊤)) →+
      Γ((Modules.tensorPullback f).obj G, ⊤),
      Function.Bijective d ∧ ∀ (m : Γ(G, ⊤)) (b : Γ(B, ⊤)),
        d (m ⊗ₜ[Γ(A, ⊤)] b) = b • Modules.tensorSectionsUnit f G m
